text: {"question": "How was the migraine disease status classified in the OVERCOME study over the 1-year period?", "answer": "Migraine disease status was categorized into three groups—\"overall improved,\" \"overall worsened,\" or \"no net change\"—based on the changes observed over one year in monthly headache days, the Migraine Disability Assessment Scale score, and the Migraine-Specific Quality-Of-Life Questionnaire-Role Function-Restrictive domain score.", "evidence": "Migraine disease status was classified as \"overall improved,\" \"overall worsened,\" or \"no net change\" based on changes in monthly headache days (MHDs), the Migraine Disability Assessment Scale (MIDAS) score, and the Migraine-Specific Quality-of-Life Questionnaire-Role Function-Restrictive (MSQ-RFR) domain score over 1 year."}
